description:
`jit query all` silently skips records it cannot parse, so a listing can hide issues with no report.

## Background

In `~/Projects/research`, `query all` shows 52 of 76 issues. The other 24 hold a `gates_status.*.updated_by` that fails identity parsing (`jit validate` reports `PARSE_ERROR`). A reader of the listing cannot tell that anything is missing, which defeats the point of validation.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit query all`, and any other listing built on the same read, either fails loudly on a record it cannot parse, naming it, or reports each skipped record in both human and `--json` output.
- [hard] REQ-02: A test owns the behaviour on a repository with one malformed record.

## Notes

- Decide one behaviour for every listing path through the same read, rather than one at each command (`@/inv/convention-convergence`).
title: Query all silently skips malformed records
